diagnostics.what: the dataset is empty; the ground's empty state is drawn

diagnostics.what: a value cannot be drawn as given (null, not finite, or outside the data contract); it is corrected or omitted
diagnostics.todo: Check the value against the chart's data contract (Data Model §2)

diagnostics.what: the container measures 0 px; the render is deferred
diagnostics.todo: Give the container a size, or pin `width` and `height`

diagnostics.what: the scale domain has zero length; it is expanded with the ground's domainPadding
diagnostics.todo: Nothing to do if the data is constant; otherwise check the accessor

diagnostics.what: more than one element is marked with white heightening; only the first is applied
diagnostics.todo: Heighten a single element per chart

diagnostics.what: the inker is not registered; falling back to NullInker
diagnostics.todo: Register the inker or fix the ground's `inker` token

diagnostics.what: the ground is not registered; falling back to silverpoint
diagnostics.todo: Call registerGround() before rendering, or fix the name

diagnostics.what: the data volume is above the family's threshold
diagnostics.todo: Aggregate the data before charting it

diagnostics.what: a scale bound cannot be derived from the data and was not supplied
diagnostics.todo: Pass the named property explicitly

diagnostics.what: the chord ring has more than 12 categories
diagnostics.todo: Group the smaller categories

diagnostics.what: the path byte budget of 40 KB is exceeded
diagnostics.todo: Use `hatchFill: 'tile'` or a larger hatch gap

diagnostics.what: the ground does not reach the minimum contrast
diagnostics.todo: Recompute the palette; colours are not chosen by eye

diagnostics.what: the @silverpoint/fonts face failed to load; rendering fell back to the system stack
diagnostics.todo: Install @silverpoint/fonts and import its stylesheet; golden images will not match until then

diagnostics.what: a dashboard cell spans more columns than the breakpoint has; it is clamped
diagnostics.todo: Lower the span, or give that breakpoint more columns

diagnostics.what: the dashboard layout and its children disagree; unmatched children are placed in source order, span 1
diagnostics.todo: Give every child a `cell` the layout declares, once

diagnostics.what: a chart in a linked dashboard has no field named by `link.key`; it shows no linked mark
diagnostics.todo: Link on a field every linked chart carries, or leave this chart out of the link

diagnostics.what: a value or a range cannot be drawn as given; it is clamped, rounded to its step or defaulted
diagnostics.todo: Keep the value within `min`..`max` and on `step`, with `min < max` and `step > 0`

diagnostics.what: the component has no accessible name: no text content and no `label`
diagnostics.todo: Give it visible text, or a `label` for an icon-only control

diagnostics.what: items share a key, or have none; the first is kept and the later ones are skipped
diagnostics.todo: Give every item a unique, non-empty `key`

diagnostics.what: the hierarchy is invalid (a duplicate or empty `id`, a missing `parent`, a cycle, or several roots); the offending rows are dropped
diagnostics.todo: Give every row a unique `id` and an existing `parent`, under a single root

diagnostics.what: a statistic parameter is invalid; its default is used
diagnostics.todo: Keep the parameter in its documented range

diagnostics.what: a group has too few observations for its statistic; they are drawn as points
diagnostics.todo: Give the group more observations, or expect it drawn as points

diagnostics.what: a palette colour is below its contrast threshold against its substrate; it is drawn as given
diagnostics.todo: Recompute the palette with checkPalette(); colours are not chosen by eye

diagnostics.what: a palette field is unknown, or its value is not a CSS colour; the field is dropped
diagnostics.todo: Use the fields of PALETTE_PROPERTIES with plain CSS colour values

diagnostics.what: @knight-lab/timelinejs could not be loaded; the fallback is rendered
diagnostics.todo: Install the optional peer @knight-lab/timelinejs and import its stylesheet
